title: Baselines report over every baselines run
description: experiments/baselines_report.py over the episodes of the baselines runs given as inputs: exp-baselines-192 (expliCCit's released policy as deployed, Sage's released policy, BBRv1, BBRv3, Cubic and Vegas on the 27 test links of every held-out family and as 2 and 4 copies, the two policies run as agent) and exp-baselines-pure-194 (the two policies again as agent_pure, Sage's kernel pacing, named expliccit-pure and sage-pure) and exp-baselines-orca-197 (Orca's released policy, exp-orca-model-196, as an agent_cubic agent with a 20 ms period, named orca) and exp-baselines-aurora-204 (three Auroras trained with PCC-RL's code, exp-aurora-model-203, as agent_rate agents, each as trained, blind and unbiased, named aurora-I, aurora-blind-I and aurora-unbiased-I; and every controller on Aurora's training links, family aurora-range). Runs no episodes: it rewrites the report, so a fix to the report or a later run of more controllers on the same links (campaign seed 31) is published from the same data. A competitor that is the observed flow's own controller is named, so Cubic against Cubic sits in the table of everyone against Cubic.
